review_notes: I read the whole target file and grepped the AnomalousDiffusion tree for copies of its helper lemmas. The strongest hit is an exact proof-level duplicate of `spaceTimeGrad_integrable`, `square_triangle'` and `spaceTimeGrad_triangle` in `H1Reduction.lean`. I did not check the full transitive import graph of `H1Reduction.lean` (it imports Heat.FrozenEstimates, Ingredients.EpsilonConsequences and others). findings.problem: These three declarations repeat, almost line for line, `H1Reduction.st_integrable`, `H1Reduction.square_triangle` and `H1Reduction.st_triangle` in `H1Reduction.lean`. The repeated reasoning is nontrivial. It turns `MemLp 2` of each component into integrability of the squared components by `integrable_norm_rpow`, the `ENNReal.toReal` rewrite and `rpow_two`. It sums over `Fin 2` with `integrable_finsetSum`. It then proves the pointwise bound `|E|² ≤ 2|D|² + 2|D−E|²` via `Finset.sum_le_sum` on the scalar inequality. Finally it integrates with `integral_mono`, `integral_add` and `integral_const_mul`. The two copies have identical statements and proof scripts apart from names. The only difference is that the target one is not a `H1Reduction.` declaration and has a docstring. Two copies must be kept in sync, and readers cannot tell that they are the same fact.
findings.proposed_change: Prefer reusing the existing lemmas. Add `public import LeanPool.AnomalousDiffusion.AVenhance.Infra.Section5.H1Reduction` (which `AssemblyDissipation.lean` and `AnomalousDissipation.lean` already import) and delete the local `spaceTimeGrad_integrable`, `AssemblyGradient.square_triangle'` and `spaceTimeGrad_triangle`. Then change `htri` in `weak_dissipation_ge_classical` to `have htri := H1Reduction.st_triangle (D := Dθ) (E := fun t x => spaceGrad (θM t) x) hθ.2.2.2.1 hM.2.2.2.1`. The lemma statement is unchanged: for `hD hE : ∀ i, MemLp (fun p => D p.1 p.2 i) 2 (volume.restrict timeCube)` it gives `spaceTimeGradNormSq E ≤ 2 * spaceTimeGradNormSq D + 2 * spaceTimeGradNormSq (fun t x => D t x - E t x)`. The hypotheses at the use site are the same, so the call needs no change beyond the name. If the import is not acyclic, move the three lemmas into a small shared module imported by both files. In either case `H1Reduction.st_triangle` would use the shared copy as well. The duplicate pair `H1Reduction.st_integrable` and `spaceTimeGrad_integrable` is the one that needs unifying. External users of `spaceTimeGrad_triangle` or `spaceTimeGrad_integrable` can be redirected to the shared names. My grep found none outside this file.
findings.benefit: About 37 lines of non-trivial integrability and triangle-inequality proof are removed. The energy-gradient triangle inequality then has a single source of truth. Future fixes, such as changes to the `MemLp` hypotheses or to `spaceTimeGradNormSq`, are made once. The target file shrinks to the `weighted_triangle_real` step and the final assembly, which is the new content of this file.
